name: Robot Path
description: Program a toy robot with arrow cards to collect gems. Later levels add repeats, an if card and fewest-moves puzzles.

about.concept: Sequencing and abstraction, the foundations of programming. Arrow cards move a robot; the child plans the whole path before running it, then shortens it with repeats and conditions.
about.progression: Straight paths lead to turns, then obstacles, then a repeat card, an if card, and puzzles that must be solved in the fewest moves.
